items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah! Specs Odum was the piano player for them. [INTERVIEWEE] No, I was the piano player for them.

ctx.x: And out of that, I began to play for an excellent group from Cincinnati that had come to New York called the Charioteers, a singing group.
Oh yeah! Specs Odum was the piano player for them.
No, I was the piano player for them.
